verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar has documented public API reference pages for its core objects: reviews (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), early fraud warnings, and value lists that feed rules, so an agent can drive key Radar workflows programmatically. One community comment cites 'lack of easy programmatic control', but that is a general complaint, not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: documented API control of custom rules and risk settings (the docs describe these as Dashboard features), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed docs paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven Radar use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Value lists allow you to group values together which can then be referenced in rules.
An early fraud warning indicates that the card issuer has notified us that a charge may be fraudulent.
